title: AlwaysOpenWaterNeoforge
description: This mod will keep the water always open!
body:
Tthis is the neoforge port of [AlwaysOpenWater](https://modrinth.com/mod/alwaysopenwater).

In Minecraft 1.16+, fishing for treasure requires open water, but this mod removes that restriction, allowing you to still catch treasure even in a single block of water.
